versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Flipkart Seller Dashboard for Indian e-commerce sellers.
- Tracks orders, returns, inventory, competitor pricing, and Buy Box status on Flipkart (and optionally Amazon India).
- Sends daily WhatsApp morning summaries with business insights, restock alerts, and performance metrics.
- Includes real-time commands for order management, inventory checks, price updates, and shipment tracking.
- Provides weekly performance reports and supports configurable inventory and pricing alert thresholds.
